sara_harrison: FYI: we're changing the Starter free slab to a time-bound onboarding bundle. 90-day notice; cutover 2026-06-01. Short details below. :loudspeaker:

matt_lee: New onboarding = 7-day trial + $50 one-time credit for new signups. Dedicated & enterprise unchanged.

anna_finance: Finance will prorate remaining legacy credits and issue a single invoice credit. No retro billing. CSV of affected accounts due 2026-05-10; dry-run 2026-05-17.

jessica_support: Support playbook + canned replies will land in #help today. Key line: "Your existing credits will be honored or prorated."

marco_marketing: Comms plan: in-console banner + customer email on 2026-05-15, blog FAQ 2026-05-20. Will work with legal on copy.

sara_harrison: Action items: matt export top-100 affected list (TOM); anna run proration; jessica publish playbook; marco prepare banner copy. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
